import re, sys
assert 'Thm' in dir() and 'ABGRP' in dir(), "run the kernel-definition cell first"

TOOL, TOOLVER = "muk", "0.1"

# ===================== 1. TERM  <->  S-EXPRESSION ============================
def ser(t):
    if isinstance(t, Var):   return t.name
    if isinstance(t, Zero):  return "zero"
    if isinstance(t, Nil):   return "nil"
    if isinstance(t, Add):   return "(add %s %s)"   % (ser(t.a), ser(t.b))
    if isinstance(t, Sub):   return "(sub %s %s)"   % (ser(t.a), ser(t.b))
    if isinstance(t, Sum):   return "(sum %s)"      % ser(t.v)
    if isinstance(t, Elem):  return "(eltsub %s %s)"% (ser(t.a), ser(t.b))
    if isinstance(t, Cons):  return "(cons %s %s)"  % (ser(t.h), ser(t.t))
    raise TypeError(t)

def _build(op, args):
    return {"add": Add, "sub": Sub, "sum": Sum,
            "eltsub": Elem, "cons": Cons}[op](*args)

def parse_term(s):
    toks = re.findall(r"\(|\)|[^\s()]+", s); pos = 0
    def rd():
        nonlocal pos
        tk = toks[pos]; pos += 1
        if tk == "(":
            op = toks[pos]; pos += 1; args = []
            while toks[pos] != ")":
                args.append(rd())
            pos += 1
            return _build(op, args)
        return {"zero": Zero, "nil": Nil}.get(tk, lambda: Var(tk))()
    t = rd(); assert pos == len(toks), "trailing tokens in %r" % s
    return t

# ===================== 2. RULE REGISTRY =====================================
RULES = {
    "refl":          (REFL,          1, 0), "sym": (SYM, 0, 1), "trans": (TRANS, 0, 2),
    "add_cong":      (ADD_CONG,      0, 2), "sub_cong":  (SUB_CONG,  0, 2),
    "sum_cong":      (SUM_CONG,      0, 1), "elem_cong": (ELEM_CONG, 0, 2),
    "cons_cong":     (CONS_CONG,     0, 2),
    "def_sum_nil":   (lambda: DEF_SUM_NIL(),  0, 0),
    "def_sum_cons":  (DEF_SUM_CONS,  2, 0),
    "def_elem_nil":  (lambda: DEF_ELEM_NIL(), 0, 0),
    "def_elem_cons": (DEF_ELEM_CONS, 4, 0),
    "def_sub":       (DEF_SUB,       2, 0),
    "ax_abgrp":      (ABGRP,         2, 0),
    "assume":        (ASSUME,        2, 0),
    "ax_assoc":      (AX_ASSOC,      3, 0), "ax_comm": (AX_COMM, 2, 0),
    "ax_zero":       (AX_ZERO,       1, 0), "ax_neg":  (AX_NEG,  1, 0),
    "induct":        (INDUCT,        0, 2),
}

# ===================== 3. REBUILT CERTIFICATE ===============================
x, xs, y, ys = Var("x"), Var("xs"), Var("y"), Var("ys")
GOAL = ("forall a b : vector(R), len(a) = len(b) => "
        "sum(eltsub(a,b)) = sum(a) - sum(b)")

S = []
def st(i, r, params=(), prem=()):
    S.append((i, r, list(params), list(prem)))

# ---- base  n=0 :  sum(eltsub(nil,nil)) = sum(nil) - sum(nil) ----------------
st("e_nil",     "def_elem_nil")                              # eltsub(nil,nil) = nil
st("sum_e_nil", "sum_cong", prem=["e_nil"])                  #   ... lifted by sum
st("s_nil",     "def_sum_nil")                               # sum(nil) = 0
st("base_l",    "trans", prem=["sum_e_nil", "s_nil"])        # 0 = 0
st("sn1",       "def_sum_nil"); st("sn2", "def_sum_nil")
st("rhs_l",     "sub_cong", prem=["sn1", "sn2"])             # sum(nil)-sum(nil) = 0-0
st("ab0",       "ax_abgrp", params=[Zero(), Sub(Zero(), Zero())])
st("rhs_l_inv", "sym", prem=["rhs_l"])
st("t1",        "trans", prem=["ab0", "rhs_l_inv"])
st("base",      "trans", prem=["base_l", "t1"])              # BASE

# ---- step :  IH  =>  cons case ---------------------------------------------
st("ih", "assume", params=[Sum(Elem(xs, ys)), Sub(Sum(xs), Sum(ys))])
st("refl_xy",    "refl",          params=[Sub(x, y)])
st("h1",         "def_elem_cons", params=[x, xs, y, ys])     # eltsub(...) = cons(...)
st("sh1",        "sum_cong",      prem=["h1"])               #   ... lifted by sum
st("h2",         "def_sum_cons",  params=[Sub(x, y), Elem(xs, ys)])
st("h12",        "trans",         prem=["sh1", "h2"])
st("h3",         "add_cong",      prem=["refl_xy", "ih"])
st("lhs_chain",  "trans",         prem=["h12", "h3"])
st("r1", "def_sum_cons", params=[x, xs]); st("r2", "def_sum_cons", params=[y, ys])
st("rhs_chain",  "sub_cong",      prem=["r1", "r2"])
st("leaf",       "ax_abgrp",
   params=[Add(Sub(x, y), Sub(Sum(xs), Sum(ys))),
           Sub(Add(x, Sum(xs)), Add(y, Sum(ys)))])
st("rhs_chain_inv", "sym",   prem=["rhs_chain"])
st("t2",            "trans", prem=["leaf", "rhs_chain_inv"])
st("step",          "trans", prem=["lhs_chain", "t2"])       # STEP
st("final",         "induct", prem=["base", "step"])         # FINAL

HEADER = ["%s/cert@%s" % (TOOL, TOOLVER),
          "# declaration: sum_of_elementwise_differences",
          "sort   R", "sort   vector(R)", "const  zero    : R",
          "const  nil     : vector(R)", "func   add     : R,R -> R",
          "func   sub     : R,R -> R", "func   sum     : vector(R) -> R",
          "func   eltsub  : vector(R),vector(R) -> vector(R)",
          "func   cons    : R,vector(R) -> vector(R)"]
BODY = ["step %-15s : %-14s params=[%s] from=[%s]"
        % (i, r, ",".join(ser(p) for p in ps), ",".join(prem))
        for (i, r, ps, prem) in S]
CERT = "\n".join(HEADER + BODY + ["goal " + GOAL]) + "\n"
open("sum_eltsub.muk", "w").write(CERT)
print("=== %s (example/cert, %d bytes) ===" % (HEADER[0], len(CERT)))
print("\n".join(BODY)); print("goal " + GOAL)

# ===================== 4. INDEPENDENT RE-CHECKER ============================
def parse_cert(text):
    steps, goal = [], None
    pat = re.compile(r"^step\s+(\S+)\s*:\s*(\S+)\s*"
                     r"params=\[([^\]]*)\]\s*from=\[([^\]]*)\]\s*$")
    for ln in text.splitlines():
        ln = ln.strip()
        if ln.startswith("step "):
            m = pat.match(ln); assert m, "bad step line: %r" % ln
            ps = [parse_term(p) for p in m.group(3).split(",") if p.strip()]
            pr = [p.strip() for p in m.group(4).split(",") if p.strip()]
            steps.append((m.group(1), m.group(2), ps, pr))
        elif ln.startswith("goal "):
            goal = ln[5:].strip()
    return steps, goal

steps, goal = parse_cert(open("sum_eltsub.muk").read())
print("\n=== re-checking %d steps from file (kernel = trust boundary) ===" % len(steps))
env = {}
for (i, r, ps, pr) in steps:
    fn, na, np_ = RULES[r]
    assert len(ps) == na,  "%s: %s wants %d params"  % (i, r, na)
    assert len(pr) == np_, "%s: %s wants %d premises"% (i, r, np_)
    env[i] = fn(*[env[p] for p in pr], *ps)
    print("  %-15s %-14s %s" % (i, r, env[i]))

final = env["final"]
print("\n=== verdict ===")
print("derived :", final.l.text)
print("stated  :", goal)
print("MATCH   :", final.l.text == goal)
print("sound?  :", len(final.hyps) == 0, "(0 open hypotheses)")
print("kernel  :", TOOL, TOOLVER, "| python", sys.version.split()[0], "| deps: none")

clean = lambda d: {k: v for k, v in d.items() if v != 0}
print("\n=== audit of 'ax_abgrp' leaves (normal forms must coincide) ===")
for (i, r, ps, pr) in steps:
    if r == "ax_abgrp":
        print("  %-6s LNF %s" % (i, clean(_norm(ps[0]))))
        print("  %-6s RNF %s" % ("", clean(_norm(ps[1]))))
